description: Defines the MemoryRegion class interface for accessing virtual memory regions, including methods for retrieving memory at specific addresses and printing the object.

classes.name: MemoryRegion
classes.description: Abstract class providing virtual access to a range of memory, with methods for retrieving memory contents and printing information.

methods.name: GetBase
methods.description: Returns the base address of the memory region.

methods.name: GetSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the memory region.

methods.name: GetMemoryAtAddress
methods.description: Retrieves memory data at a specified address for different data sizes (8, 16, 32, 64 bits).

methods.name: Print
methods.description: Outputs a human-readable representation of the memory region.
